description: GitHub Actions workflow running every check on pushes and pull requests.

features: GitHub Actions CI: lint, typecheck, Medha style check, tests and build on every push and pull request

sections.title: Continuous integration
sections.body: `.github/workflows/ci.yml` installs exactly what your lockfile lists (`{{ ciInstall }}`), then runs the same checks as you do locally. Commit the lockfile your package manager created, or the install step fails.
